title: SharePoint: agent access heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive sites
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, preview status, licence prerequisites and control paths are supported. Microsoft has conflicting reference text about site-command applicability and the older report's availability; these documentation differences should be noted, but do not invalidate the controls documented by the cited feature guides.
